raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Depends on an SGLang pin of sgl-amd-mono at or after [`0a107f1`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono/commit/0a107f15362714c45be34ca37e4dec286fa3d303) ([sgl-amd-mono#60](https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono/pull/60)): done. [sglang#46902](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46902) and [sglang#46951](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46951) pin [`90c2355`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono/commit/90c23551a323d5badd5b86c1e92151e319072d87). The first MI35x image with this pin is `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261028` (`sha256:2456fff6cfaf`). Section 3.6 now names this image, and its command runs on it (tables below).

The next pin brings [sgl-amd-mono#85](https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono/pull/85) and [#86](https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono/pull/86) (`ca929b7d`), which cut the monokernel's decode ITL by about 10 % at concurrency 1 to 4 on the section 3.6 command (local A/B below). `main` pins `b10f3b71` ([sglang#47483](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47483)), which does not contain them; the daily bump bot ([sglang#46685](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46685)) opens that pin. When an MI35x nightly contains it, section 3.6 will name that image and the published-image tables will be measured again on it.

## Motivation

The GLM-5.3 page keeps MTP off on MI355X. No AMD Deploy cell has MTP flags, the Playground turns off both MTP presets on AMD, and the reasons say that more than 3 steps hit a build issue on gfx950. On the page's own MI355X image with the FP8 cells' flags, EAGLE 1-1-2, 3-1-4, and 5-1-6 serve at the GSM8K score of no MTP, and 3-1-4 decodes one request 2.2 times as fast as no MTP. Only 5-1-6 on the high-throughput cell fails: it runs out of memory at startup (tables below).

The page also has no MI355X recipe with MTP, an FP8 KV cache, or the AMD monokernel. On one MI355X node at TP8, EAGLE 3-1-4 with `fp8_e4m3` KV runs, and adding the monokernel improves all three InferenceX AgentX headline metrics (throughput, P90 interactivity, P90 E2EL) at concurrency 1, 2, 4, and 10 (tables below).

InferenceX accepts a recipe only when its production-useful flags are on a merged cookbook page, as [#45693](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45693) did for DeepSeek-V4.1 before [InferenceX#4367](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4367). This page change comes before the GLM-5.3 MI355X submission.

## Modifications

- `glm-5.3.jsx`:
  - The MI355X FP8 low-latency Deploy cell serves EAGLE 3-1-4. At one request, 3-1-4 decodes faster than 5-1-6 and 1-1-2 on MI355X, and section 3.6 uses the same draft.
  - The Playground's two MTP presets are on for the MI355X FP8 cells, except 5-1-6 on the high-throughput cell (startup OOM). They stay off for BF16 on MI355X and for MI300X and MI325X, which did not run. The reasons no longer say that more than 3 steps hit a build issue.
  - The AMD cell comment says which cell serves MTP.
- `GLM-5.3.mdx`: new section 3.6, "Agentic Long-Context on MI355X (FP8, MTP)". It gives the command and the admission limit per concurrency, in the form of section 3.6 of the DeepSeek-V4.1 page. It names the first MI35x image that runs the command, `v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261028`. The section-2 AMD tip now says which MI355X cell serves MTP, where the presets run, and where MTP is not validated. It also keeps the MXFP4 AgentX commands that [#46825](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46825) added to the same tip.
- Unchanged: the images, the benchmarks, the other AMD cells, and `verified: false` on all AMD cells. The BF16 cells keep no MTP because no BF16 checkpoint ran. `--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3` lowers KV precision, so it goes in section 3.6 and not in a Deploy cell.
- Left out of the section-3.6 command: harness-only settings (served model name, metrics, keep-alive, and the synthetic acceptance `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_*`), and `SGLANG_OPT_USE_TOPK_V2=false`, which [`model_hook.py`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/5aeb6dfdb64895c7ef17fd385aba3a6ef28ed92a/python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/model_hook.py#L441-L443) already sets for DSA models on HIP.
- No test: documentation-only change.

## Accuracy Tests

### sgl-amd-mono #85 and #86 (the next pin) on the section 3.6 command

The servers of the local A/B in Speed Tests, with real MTP acceptance. GSM8K through InferenceX's eval harness (lm-eval, 5-shot, chat template), all 1319 questions, concurrency 2, MI355X TP8.

| sgl-amd-mono | strict-match | flexible-extract | Median accept length |
|---|---|---|---|
| `517040fb` (before #85) | 0.9727 | 0.9719 | 3.44 |
| `ca929b7d` (after #86) | 0.9765 | 0.9750 | 3.43 |

- Strict-match pairs: 2 questions only `517040fb` answers right and 7 only `ca929b7d` does; exact McNemar p = 0.18.

### MTP in the MI355X FP8 cells

The page's MI355X image `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.20-rocm720-mi35x-20260920` (`sha256:9a866d8fed2d`, SGLang `6880a4795533`), `zai-org/GLM-5.3` revision `ba32f8c1`, 8x MI355X, and a fresh server per row with the cell's flags plus the MTP flags. GSM8K: sgl-eval 0.1.3, all 1319 questions, temperature 0, thinking off, 64, 80, and 256 requests at a time on the low-latency, balanced, and high-throughput cells. Pairs count the questions that only the no-MTP low-latency run answers right / only the row answers right.

| Cell | MTP | Server starts | GSM8K | Pairs | McNemar p | Accept length |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| low-latency | off | yes | 0.973 | | | |
| low-latency | 1-1-2 | yes | 0.975 | 6 / 9 | 0.61 | 1.93 |
| low-latency | 3-1-4 | yes | 0.974 | 5 / 7 | 0.77 | 3.37 |
| low-latency | 5-1-6 | yes | 0.970 | 9 / 6 | 0.61 | 4.20 |
| balanced | 1-1-2 | yes | 0.976 | 3 / 7 | 0.34 | 1.93 |
| balanced | 5-1-6 | yes | 0.971 | 9 / 7 | 0.80 | 3.73 |
| high-throughput | 1-1-2 | yes | 0.976 | 4 / 9 | 0.27 | 1.90 |
| high-throughput | 5-1-6 | no: HIP OOM | | | | |

- Accept length is the median over the server's decode-batch log lines during GSM8K.
- The high-throughput cell with 5-1-6 runs out of memory while it captures the draft-extend CUDA graphs: the DSA indexer asks for a 6 GiB logits buffer (1536 tokens x 1M context x FP32) when 5.4 GiB is free at `--mem-fraction-static 0.85`. The Playground keeps 5-1-6 off on that cell.

### Section 3.6 on the published image

Image `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261028` (`sha256:2456fff6cfaf`): SGLang `5d8e90a0f9`, sgl-amd-mono `90c2355`, AITER `285579b6`, no overlay. GSM8K, all 1319 questions, strict-match, real MTP acceptance, InferenceX's eval harness (`inferencex-e2e`), MI355X TP8. Base is the section-3.6 command without `--enable-amd-monokernel`.

| Concurrency | Base | Monokernel | Only base right / only monokernel right | McNemar p |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | 0.977 | 0.976 | 5 / 4 | 1.00 |
| 10 | 0.977 | 0.977 | 6 / 6 | 1.00 |

### Section 3.6 with an overlay (image 20261024 + sgl-amd-mono `0a107f1`)

GSM8K, all 1319 questions, strict-match, real MTP acceptance, InferenceX's eval harness (`inferencex-e2e`), MI355X TP8. Base is the section-3.6 command without `--enable-amd-monokernel`.

| Pair | Concurrency | Base | Monokernel | Only base right / only monokernel right | McNemar p |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| run 1 | 10 | 0.978 | 0.972 | 11 / 3 | 0.06 |
| run 2 | 10 | 0.976 | 0.979 | 3 / 7 | 0.34 |
| run 1 | 2 | 0.974 | 0.971 | 10 / 6 | 0.45 |
| pooled | | | | 24 / 16 | 0.27 |
| monokernel run 1 vs run 2 | 10 | 0.972 | 0.979 | 3 / 12 | 0.04 |

- Two runs of the monokernel arm differ more than the first base-vs-monokernel pair does, so that asymmetry is run-to-run variation.
- Share of the server's decode-batch log lines with at most 2 running requests, which the kernel serves: 100% at concurrency 2, and 22% and 25% in the two runs at concurrency 10.
- FP8 against BF16 KV, 500 questions at concurrency 2: FP8 KV without the monokernel 0.980, BF16 KV with the monokernel 0.984 (2 / 4, p = 0.69). This pair changes two settings at once. It shows no FP8-KV loss at this sample size.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

### sgl-amd-mono #85 and #86 (the next pin) on the section 3.6 command (local 900 s, overlay)

- 8x MI355X (gfx950), TP8 EP1, `zai-org/GLM-5.3` revision `ba32f8c1` (FP8), the section 3.6 command.
- Image `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.23-rocm720-mi35x-20261103` (`sha256:4c9b1497e379`): SGLang `035670b685`, AITER `285579b6`. sgl-amd-mono mounted over the bundled `b10f3b71`: `517040fb` (main before #85; its GLM-5.3 and common code equals `b10f3b71`) against `ca929b7d` (main after #86).
- InferenceX AgentX client (InferenceX `b5bc8485`, agentx-harness 1.0.12), a 900-s window per point, a fresh server per point and arm, the arm order swapped per point, and synthetic acceptance at the golden accept length (2.99) in both arms.

Matched requests (same conversation and turn), `ca929b7d` against `517040fb`: the median per-request change with a bootstrap 95 % interval.

| Concurrency | Matched | ITL | TTFT | E2E latency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 111 | −9.6% [−9.9, −9.1] | +1.0% [+0.4, +2.2] | −6.0% [−7.1, −4.6] |
| 2 | 124 | −10.6% [−13.0, −10.0] | −0.4% [−1.5, +0.3] | −8.8% [−9.7, −7.7] |
| 4 | 208 | −10.4% [−13.1, −8.3] | −0.6% [−2.2, 0.0] | −7.2% [−9.4, −5.4] |
| 10 | 581 | −1.7% [−2.9, 0.0] | −0.1% [−1.5, +1.2] | −2.2% [−3.2, −0.7] |
| 1, A/A of `517040fb` | 111 | −0.2% [−0.5, +0.2] | +0.3% [−0.8, +2.0] | 0.0% [−0.3, +0.1] |

- At concurrency 1 the ITL gain grows with the prompt: −7.0 % below 64k tokens and −11.4 % at 192k and above.
- Aggregates, `517040fb` → `ca929b7d`: P50 decode interactivity 437.8 → 481.9 tok/s/user at concurrency 1 and 410.7 → 473.8 at 2. P90 E2E-normalized interactivity 66.9 → 73.5, 85.2 → 88.8, 86.4 → 108.9, and 61.8 → 67.0 at 1, 2, 4, and 10. The A/A pair moves P90 E2E-normalized interactivity by 6.4 %, so the 900-s aggregates are noisier than the matched requests.
- Share of decode batches with at most two running requests, which the kernel serves: 100 % at concurrency 1, 97-99 % at 2, 96-98 % at 4, and 35-37 % at 10.
- These runs mount sgl-amd-mono over the image; the tables below keep the images they name.

### MTP in the MI355X FP8 cells

Same image, checkpoint, and servers as the MTP accuracy table, after GSM8K. One greedy 512-token request on the idle server; the rate is 512 tokens over the end-to-end latency.

| Cell | MTP | Tokens/s | Against low-latency off | Verify steps |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| low-latency | off | 83.7 | 1.00x | |
| low-latency | 1-1-2 | 131.0 | 1.57x | 267 |
| low-latency | 3-1-4 | 187.1 | 2.24x | 165 |
| low-latency | 5-1-6 | 170.8 | 2.04x | 153 |
| balanced | 1-1-2 | 130.5 | 1.56x | 269 |
| balanced | 5-1-6 | 173.8 | 2.08x | 150 |
| high-throughput | 1-1-2 | 129.6 | 1.55x | 270 |

- One request per row: this ranks the settings at one request and is not a serving benchmark. 5-1-6 takes 7% fewer verify steps than 3-1-4, but each step costs more, so 3-1-4 is faster.
- Each run held all 8 GPUs after 30 idle samples, and no other process used them.

### Section 3.6 on the published image (900 s)

The image of the accuracy table above. InferenceX AgentX client, a 900-s window per point, a fresh server per arm, the arm order swapped per point, and synthetic acceptance at the golden accept length (2.99) in both arms. A 900-s A/A at c2 of another cohort on this node gives a noise floor of 8.9% for throughput and 6.8% for P90 interactivity.

| Concurrency | Throughput (tok/s/GPU) | P90 E2E-normalized interactivity (tok/s/user) | P90 E2EL (s) | ITL, same requests | E2EL, same requests |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2626 → 2788 (+6.2%) | 71.0 → 91.1 (+28.3%) | 15.2 → 11.0 | −30.7% | −26.2% |
| 2 | 2450 → 2594 (+5.9%) | 77.5 → 86.1 (+11.2%) | 16.9 → 12.7 | −29.0% | −22.2% |
| 4 | 2483 → 3096 (+24.7%) | 91.6 → 106.2 (+15.9%) | 21.1 → 15.3 | −22.3% | −15.0% |
| 10 | 7950 → 8047 (+1.2%) | 63.8 → 65.6 (+2.8%) | 16.9 → 16.8 | −2.5% | −1.7% |

- On the same requests, TTFT changes by 1.4% or less. ITL by input length (c1 + c2): −31.0% at 64k–128k, −30.4% at 128k–192k, and −28.5% at 192k or more.
- At c1, c2, and c4, P90 interactivity and P90 E2EL improve beyond the A/A floor. Throughput does so only at c4. A 900-s window holds other requests than the 3600-s runs below, so the absolute values differ.
- One monokernel request at c1 has an empty response. The same request fails in every arm of another cohort on this node, so it is a property of the request. At c2 the measured windows are 906 s (base) and 864 s (monokernel).

### Section 3.6 with an overlay (3600 s)

- 8x MI355X, TP8 EP1, `zai-org/GLM-5.3` revision `ba32f8c1` (FP8).
- Image `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261024` (`sha256:65a81d6ba18d`): SGLang `fe1bd108372c`, AITER `285579b6211b`. sgl-amd-mono `0a107f1` was installed over the bundled `05e0bb02`. That SGLang takes `--monokernel-backend amd`, the deprecated spelling that sets the same `enable_amd_monokernel` field as `--enable-amd-monokernel` on `main`.
- InferenceX AgentX client, a 3600-s window per point, a fresh server per arm, and synthetic acceptance at InferenceX's golden accept length (2.99) in both arms. A/A at concurrency 2: throughput 2.7%, P90 interactivity 1.3%, P90 E2EL 2.7%.

| Concurrency | Throughput (tok/s/GPU) | P90 E2E-normalized interactivity (tok/s/user) | P90 E2EL (s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1991 → 2377 (+19.4%) | 103.3 → 119.0 (+15.2%) | 23.3 → 19.1 |
| 2 | 2173 → 2500 (+15.1%) | 94.8 → 104.1 (+9.8%) | 22.0 → 18.4 |
| 4 | 3215 → 3683 (+14.6%) | 93.5 → 106.0 (+13.4%) | 22.1 → 17.7 |
| 10 | 6959 → 7165 (+3.0%) | 66.6 → 73.0 (+9.7%) | 23.3 → 21.5 |

- Matched requests (same conversation and turn): median ITL -26.6%, -27.2%, -17.0%, and -2.8% at concurrency 1, 2, 4, and 10. Median TTFT stays within 1.5%.
- Divergence from the MI355X FP8 low-latency cell: that cell now serves EAGLE 3-1-4 too, but it keeps BF16 KV, `--chunked-prefill-size 131072`, and `--mem-fraction-static 0.80`, and it runs without the monokernel. Neither AgentX arm ran it.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

| `ca929b7d` (after #86) | 0.9765 | 0.9750 | 3.43 |

- Strict-match pairs: 2 questions only `517040fb` answers right and 7 only `ca929b7d` does; exact McNemar p = 0.18.

### MTP in the MI355X FP8 cells

The page's MI355X image `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.20-rocm720-mi35x-20260920` (`sha256:9a866d8fed2d`, SGLang `6880a4795533`), `zai-org/GLM-5.3` revision `ba32f8c1`, 8x MI355X, and a fresh server per row with the cell's flags plus the MTP flags. GSM8K: sgl-eval 0.1.3, all 1319 questions, temperature 0, thinking off, 64, 80, and 256 requests at a time on the low-latency, balanced, and high-throughput cells. Pairs count the questions that only the no-MTP low-latency run answers right / only the row answers right.

| Cell | MTP | Server starts | GSM8K | Pairs | McNemar p | Accept length |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| low-latency | off | yes | 0.973 | | | |
| low-latency | 1-1-2 | yes | 0.975 | 6 / 9 | 0.61 | 1.93 |
| low-latency | 3-1-4 | yes | 0.974 | 5 / 7 | 0.77 | 3.37 |
| low-latency | 5-1-6 | yes | 0.970 | 9 / 6 | 0.61 | 4.20 |
| balanced | 1-1-2 | yes | 0.976 | 3 / 7 | 0.34 | 1.93 |
| balanced | 5-1-6 | yes | 0.971 | 9 / 7 | 0.80 | 3.73 |
| high-throughput | 1-1-2 | yes | 0.976 | 4 / 9 | 0.27 | 1.90 |
| high-throughput | 5-1-6 | no: HIP OOM | | | | |

- Accept length is the median over the server's decode-batch log lines during GSM8K.
- The high-throughput cell with 5-1-6 runs out of memory while it captures the draft-extend CUDA graphs: the DSA indexer asks for a 6 GiB logits buffer (1536 tokens x 1M context x FP32) when 5.4 GiB is free at `--mem-fraction-static 0.85`. The Playground keeps 5-1-6 off on that cell.

### Section 3.6 on the published image

Image `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261028` (`sha256:2456fff6cfaf`): SGLang `5d8e90a0f9`, sgl-amd-mono `90c2355`, AITER `285579b6`, no overlay. GSM8K, all 1319 questions, strict-match, real MTP acceptance, InferenceX's eval harness (`inferencex-e2e`), MI355X TP8. Base is the section-3.6 command without `--enable-amd-monokernel`.

| Concurrency | Base | Monokernel | Only base right / only monokernel right | McNemar p |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | 0.977 | 0.976 | 5 / 4 | 1.00 |
| 10 | 0.977 | 0.977 | 6 / 6 | 1.00 |

### Section 3.6 with an overlay (image 20261024 + sgl-amd-mono `0a107f1`)

GSM8K, all 1319 questions, strict-match, real MTP acceptance, InferenceX's eval harness (`inferencex-e2e`), MI355X TP8. Base is the section-3.6 command without `--enable-amd-monokernel`.

| Pair | Concurrency | Base | Monokernel | Only base right / only monokernel right | McNemar p |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| run 1 | 10 | 0.978 | 0.972 | 11 / 3 | 0.06 |
| run 2 | 10 | 0.976 | 0.979 | 3 / 7 | 0.34 |
| run 1 | 2 | 0.974 | 0.971 | 10 / 6 | 0.45 |
| pooled | | | | 24 / 16 | 0.27 |
| monokernel run 1 vs run 2 | 10 | 0.972 | 0.979 | 3 / 12 | 0.04 |

- Two runs of the monokernel arm differ more than the first base-vs-monokernel pair does, so that asymmetry is run-to-run variation.
- Share of the server's decode-batch log lines with at most 2 running requests, which the kernel serves: 100% at concurrency 2, and 22% and 25% in the two runs at concurrency 10.
- FP8 against BF16 KV, 500 questions at concurrency 2: FP8 KV without the monokernel 0.980, BF16 KV with the monokernel 0.984 (2 / 4, p = 0.69). This pair changes two settings at once. It shows no FP8-KV loss at this sample size.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

### sgl-amd-mono #85 and #86 (the next pin) on the section 3.6 command (local 900 s, overlay)

- 8x MI355X (gfx950), TP8 EP1, `zai-org/GLM-5.3` revision `ba32f8c1` (FP8), the section 3.6 command.
- Image `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.23-rocm720-mi35x-20261103` (`sha256:4c9b1497e379`): SGLang `035670b685`, AITER `285579b6`. sgl-amd-mono mounted over the bundled `b10f3b71`: `517040fb` (main before #85; its GLM-5.3 and common code equals `b10f3b71`) against `ca929b7d` (main after #86).
- InferenceX AgentX client (InferenceX `b5bc8485`, agentx-harness 1.0.12), a 900-s window per point, a fresh server per point and arm, the arm order swapped per point, and synthetic acceptance at the golden accept length (2.99) in both arms.

Matched requests (same conversation and turn), `ca929b7d` against `517040fb`: the median per-request change with a bootstrap 95 % interval.

| Concurrency | Matched | ITL | TTFT | E2E latency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 111 | −9.6% [−9.9, −9.1] | +1.0% [+0.4, +2.2] | −6.0% [−7.1, −4.6] |
| 2 | 124 | −10.6% [−13.0, −10.0] | −0.4% [−1.5, +0.3] | −8.8% [−9.7, −7.7] |
| 4 | 208 | −10.4% [−13.1, −8.3] | −0.6% [−2.2, 0.0] | −7.2% [−9.4, −5.4] |
| 10 | 581 | −1.7% [−2.9, 0.0] | −0.1% [−1.5, +1.2] | −2.2% [−3.2, −0.7] |
| 1, A/A of `517040fb` | 111 | −0.2% [−0.5, +0.2] | +0.3% [−0.8, +2.0] | 0.0% [−0.3, +0.1] |

- At concurrency 1 the ITL gain grows with the prompt: −7.0 % below 64k tokens and −11.4 % at 192k and above.
- Aggregates, `517040fb` → `ca929b7d`: P50 decode interactivity 437.8 → 481.9 tok/s/user at concurrency 1 and 410.7 → 473.8 at 2. P90 E2E-normalized interactivity 66.9 → 73.5, 85.2 → 88.8, 86.4 → 108.9, and 61.8 → 67.0 at 1, 2, 4, and 10. The A/A pair moves P90 E2E-normalized interactivity by 6.4 %, so the 900-s aggregates are noisier than the matched requests.
- Share of decode batches with at most two running requests, which the kernel serves: 100 % at concurrency 1, 97-99 % at 2, 96-98 % at 4, and 35-37 % at 10.
- These runs mount sgl-amd-mono over the image; the tables below keep the images they name.

### MTP in the MI355X FP8 cells

Same image, checkpoint, and servers as the MTP accuracy table, after GSM8K. One greedy 512-token request on the idle server; the rate is 512 tokens over the end-to-end latency.

| Cell | MTP | Tokens/s | Against low-latency off | Verify steps |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| low-latency | off | 83.7 | 1.00x | |
| low-latency | 1-1-2 | 131.0 | 1.57x | 267 |
| low-latency | 3-1-4 | 187.1 | 2.24x | 165 |
| low-latency | 5-1-6 | 170.8 | 2.04x | 153 |
| balanced | 1-1-2 | 130.5 | 1.56x | 269 |
| balanced | 5-1-6 | 173.8 | 2.08x | 150 |
| high-throughput | 1-1-2 | 129.6 | 1.55x | 270 |

- One request per row: this ranks the settings at one request and is not a serving benchmark. 5-1-6 takes 7% fewer verify steps than 3-1-4, but each step costs more, so 3-1-4 is faster.
- Each run held all 8 GPUs after 30 idle samples, and no other process used them.

### Section 3.6 on the published image (900 s)

The image of the accuracy table above. InferenceX AgentX client, a 900-s window per point, a fresh server per arm, the arm order swapped per point, and synthetic acceptance at the golden accept length (2.99) in both arms. A 900-s A/A at c2 of another cohort on this node gives a noise floor of 8.9% for throughput and 6.8% for P90 interactivity.

| Concurrency | Throughput (tok/s/GPU) | P90 E2E-normalized interactivity (tok/s/user) | P90 E2EL (s) | ITL, same requests | E2EL, same requests |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2626 → 2788 (+6.2%) | 71.0 → 91.1 (+28.3%) | 15.2 → 11.0 | −30.7% | −26.2% |
| 2 | 2450 → 2594 (+5.9%) | 77.5 → 86.1 (+11.2%) | 16.9 → 12.7 | −29.0% | −22.2% |
| 4 | 2483 → 3096 (+24.7%) | 91.6 → 106.2 (+15.9%) | 21.1 → 15.3 | −22.3% | −15.0% |
| 10 | 7950 → 8047 (+1.2%) | 63.8 → 65.6 (+2.8%) | 16.9 → 16.8 | −2.5% | −1.7% |

- On the same requests, TTFT changes by 1.4% or less. ITL by input length (c1 + c2): −31.0% at 64k–128k, −30.4% at 128k–192k, and −28.5% at 192k or more.
- At c1, c2, and c4, P90 interactivity and P90 E2EL improve beyond the A/A floor. Throughput does so only at c4. A 900-s window holds other requests than the 3600-s runs below, so the absolute values differ.
- One monokernel request at c1 has an empty response. The same request fails in every arm of another cohort on this node, so it is a property of the request. At c2 the measured windows are 906 s (base) and 864 s (monokernel).

### Section 3.6 with an overlay (3600 s)

- 8x MI355X, TP8 EP1, `zai-org/GLM-5.3` revision `ba32f8c1` (FP8).
- Image `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261024` (`sha256:65a81d6ba18d`): SGLang `fe1bd108372c`, AITER `285579b6211b`. sgl-amd-mono `0a107f1` was installed over the bundled `05e0bb02`. That SGLang takes `--monokernel-backend amd`, the deprecated spelling that sets the same `enable_amd_monokernel` field as `--enable-amd-monokernel` on `main`.
- InferenceX AgentX client, a 3600-s window per point, a fresh server per arm, and synthetic acceptance at InferenceX's golden accept length (2.99) in both arms. A/A at concurrency 2: throughput 2.7%, P90 interactivity 1.3%, P90 E2EL 2.7%.

| Concurrency | Throughput (tok/s/GPU) | P90 E2E-normalized interactivity (tok/s/user) | P90 E2EL (s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1991 → 2377 (+19.4%) | 103.3 → 119.0 (+15.2%) | 23.3 → 19.1 |
| 2 | 2173 → 2500 (+15.1%) | 94.8 → 104.1 (+9.8%) | 22.0 → 18.4 |
| 4 | 3215 → 3683 (+14.6%) | 93.5 → 106.0 (+13.4%) | 22.1 → 17.7 |
| 10 | 6959 → 7165 (+3.0%) | 66.6 → 73.0 (+9.7%) | 23.3 → 21.5 |

- Matched requests (same conversation and turn): median ITL -26.6%, -27.2%, -17.0%, and -2.8% at concurrency 1, 2, 4, and 10. Median TTFT stays within 1.5%.
- Divergence from the MI355X FP8 low-latency cell: that cell now serves EAGLE 3-1-4 too, but it keeps BF16 KV, `--chunked-prefill-size 131072`, and `--mem-fraction-static 0.80`, and it runs without the monokernel. Neither AgentX arm ran it.
